FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Building Window Change
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Lets the player optionally view buildings that they haven't yet unlocked through research.

patchNoteLines.li: Augments the building window with a toggle to show buildings that are locked by research or tech level

additionalNotes.li: Please raise any issues you find on the Github page.

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Event Bugfix
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Fixes for Wanderlust and Settling Down events.

patchNoteLines.li: Fixes faction-level stat calculations to actually take faction-level events into account.

additionalNotes.li: Please raise any issues you find on the Github page.

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: ResourceTypeDef update
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Small change to allow resources to be set as non-titheable, even if they aren't pool resources.

patchNoteLines.li: Adds a canTithe field to ResourceTypeDef. If false, the resource cannot be tithed.

additionalNotes.li: Please raise any issues you find on the Github page.
